header.description: Create an organization to collaborate on shared, encrypted tracker items and documents.

signed_out.description: Sharing this project needs a Nimbalyst account. Signing in or creating one is the first step.

beta.tooltip:
Nimbalyst Teams is in beta. Expect bugs.

Organizations are free during beta and will require a paid Nimbalyst Teams subscription after launch.
beta.notice_body: — expect bugs. Organizations are free during beta and will require a paid Nimbalyst Teams subscription after launch; existing organizations get advance notice before any pricing change.

encryption.title: Encryption & Privacy
encryption.description: Organization data (trackers and documents) is encrypted in transit and at rest and isolated per organization. Depending on your organization’s setup, encryption keys are either held only by members’ devices, or managed by Nimbalyst so the organization is reachable from the web, CLI, and cloud agents.
encryption.authorized_members: Only authorized organization members can access shared data
encryption.personal_sync: Your personal device sync (sessions, drafts, settings) stays zero-knowledge — keys never leave your devices
encryption.self_hosting: Need true zero-knowledge for organization data? Self-hosting is the answer

git_remote.missing_description: This workspace has no git remote. You can still share it, but a teammate’s copy is matched to a project by its git remote — without one, only this computer connects to it. Add a remote
git_remote.add_remote_suffix: if others need to work in it too.

unshared.title: Connect this project to an organization
unshared.description_after: in an organization, so its tracker items and documents sync to the people you give access.
unshared.add_existing_description: It joins as its own project, sharing the organization’s members and encryption.
unshared.create_new_description: Start a separate organization with its own members and billing.
unshared.not_in_organization: You are not in an organization yet. Create one to start sharing this project.
unshared.creation_unavailable: Creating an organization is temporarily unavailable while this is being finished. Once you are an admin of one, you can add this project to it here.
unshared.confirm_add_access: Everyone you grant access in {{organization}} can open this project’s shared tracker items and documents.
unshared.confirm_create_access: You will be the owner, and nobody else has access until you invite them.
unshared.confirm_no_remote: With no git remote, only this computer connects to the project — a teammate’s copy has nothing to match it by.
unshared.confirm_no_disk_changes: Nothing on your disk moves or changes.

project_identity.title: Project Identity
project_identity.needs_attention_description: The organization is known, but this workspace did not resolve to an explicit project id. Access editing is disabled rather than falling back to another project.
project_identity.description: Organizations link a project to its git remote, so any member who opens a clone of the same repo is automatically connected.

invite.description: You have been invited to join this organization. Accept to collaborate on shared, encrypted tracker items and documents.

actions.sign_in_or_create_account: Sign in or create an account

confirm.remove_member_message: Remove {{member}} from "{{organization}}"? They will lose access to this organization’s shared trackers and documents. This cannot be undone (you’d need to re-invite them).
confirm.stop_syncing_message: Stop syncing this project with "{{organization}}"? Its trackers and documents will no longer sync to the team. You can re-link it later.
confirm.delete_organization_message: Permanently delete organization "{{organization}}"? This will remove all members, shared documents, and encryption keys. This action cannot be undone.

move.title: Move project to another organization
move.description_after: relocates its trackers, documents, and member access into another organization. The originals are removed from this org.
move.no_destination: You don’t own or admin any other organization to move this project into.
move.encryption_block_description: This move needs both organizations on server-managed encryption. Update this team’s encryption (Security & Encryption) before moving the project.
move.slug_collision: A project with this name already exists in {{organization}}. Both will coexist; deep links may be ambiguous.
move.member_checkbox_unchecked: Uncheck to drop this member from the destination
move.member_missing_email: No email on record — cannot transfer
move.running: Moving project… relocating trackers, documents, and access.

danger.title: Danger Zone
danger.description: Leaving, ownership transfer, consolidation, and deletion are organization-scoped actions.
danger.leave_description: Your access to every organization project will be removed. Last-owner constraints are enforced by the server.
danger.leave_disabled: Leave is disabled until the collaboration server enforces last-owner invariants.
danger.merge_description: Move every project and merge the roster into another organization you administer.
danger.merge_unavailable: An admin role in this organization and another destination organization is required.
danger.transfer_description: Choose another active member before leaving or deleting an organization you own.
danger.transfer_disabled: Ownership transfer is disabled until the collaboration server enforces last-owner invariants.
danger.delete_description: Type the organization id to confirm. Server ownership and data constraints are enforced before deletion.
danger.delete_requires_admin: An organization owner or admin is required.

errors.add_project: Failed to add project to organization

messaging.title: Messaging
messaging.description: Rooms and direct messages can be turned off for organizations that chat elsewhere. The Inbox, document comments and tracker comments are unaffected.
messaging.admin_only: Only organization owners and admins can change these settings.
messaging.rooms_description: Organization rooms, including #general, and the rooms directory.
messaging.direct_messages_description: One-to-one and small-group messages between members.

projects_panel.title: Projects
projects_panel.description: Projects in this organization, including projects without a local clone.
projects_panel.organization_space_description: Reserved for shared organization documents and trackers
projects_panel.add_hint: To add a project, open it in Nimbalyst and go to Project Settings → Sharing → Add to an existing organization.

security_encryption.title: Encrypted by Nimbalyst
security_encryption.description: Team data is encrypted in transit and at rest with keys managed by Nimbalyst. This is separate from Personal sync encryption, whose keys remain only on your devices.
security_encryption.retired_description: It was never moved to Nimbalyst-managed encryption, which is now the only supported mode. Team documents and trackers are unavailable for it. Create a new organization and re-share this team's content.
security_encryption.unavailable: Encryption status is unavailable right now.

context.select_delivery: Select a delivery to see its context here, or start a new message to pick a destination.
context.access_removed: You no longer have access to the source of this delivery. Dismiss it to clear it from your inbox.
context.source_deleted: The source of this delivery was deleted. Dismiss it to clear it from your inbox.
context.bounded_preview: This is the bounded preview stored with the delivery. Open the source for the current content.
context.reply_in_source: Open the conversation above to reply.
context.read_only_reason: You can read this conversation but not post to it.
